gloss_en: God's glorification-in-Israel (hitpa'arut): the splendor/pride (pe'er) that the Blessed One takes in His people Israel, which the tzaddik reveals; corresponding to God's own tefillin in which Israel's praise is written (Likutey Moharan I:17)
canonical_he: התפארות של השם יתברך שמתפאר בישראל
